[P1] 毛毛虫童书馆
九色鹿
张世明 图
姚媛 文
新蕾出版社

[P2] 张世明 (1939— )
    1954年毕业于上海行知艺术学校，1958
年毕业于中央美术学院华东分院附中，上世纪八十年代曾在美国纽约艺术学生联盟进修
版画和壁画。寓言故事绘本《守株待兔》、
《滥竽充数》、《板桥三娘子》等曾获国际
少年儿童图书插图协会大奖。《九色鹿》获
全国儿童图画书一等奖。

[P3] 九色鹿
JIU
SE
LU
张世明 图
姚媛 文

[P4] 九色鹿住在恒河边上。那是一条很大很大的河，像玉一样洁白的九色鹿就在这条大河边上和花草、小鸟做伴，生活得安宁又幸福。他最好的朋友小乌鸦，也总是在他身旁快乐地跳着舞。
可是有一天，恒河里来了一个陌生人——他可不是走着来的，而是掉到河里被河水冲过来的。这个人在深深的河水里面浮上浮下，不停地高喊着“救命”。

[P5] 恒河的水又大又急又险，谁也不敢跳到河里去救人，只有勇敢的九色鹿不顾危险跳了进去，小鸟们在河面上着急地飞来飞去，不停地喊着“加油，加油”。
说来也怪，九色鹿跳进河后，河水立刻变得安静了。九色鹿把落水的人背在身上，并且一直带着他游上了岸，回到自己的家。

[P6] 这个名叫调达的人拼命感谢九色鹿的救命之恩，甚至跪下来说要给九色鹿当奴仆。九色鹿可不需要什么奴仆，他对调达说：“回去吧，这里不是你住的地方。不过千万记住，不要告诉别人我住在哪里。”
调达走了，九色鹿继续安宁地住在恒河边上。他没有想到的是，不久以后，这个国家的王后忽然做了一个梦，梦见了一只无比美丽、无比安详的九色鹿。

[P7] 王后立刻找到国王，说想要一只美丽的九色鹿当宠物。可是找遍整个王国，大家都不知道九色鹿住在哪里。于是国王宣布，如果有人能带他找到九色鹿，就把整个王国的一半分给他。
听到这个消息，调达简直心花怒放，他一边盘算着得到一半王国之后该怎么享受，一边赶快跑到王宫里汇报九色鹿的行踪。至于九色鹿的救命之恩和自己对九色鹿的承诺，他早就给忘了。

[P8] 调达带着国王的军队来到恒河，来到了九色鹿的家园。眼尖的乌鸦第一个看见这支庞大的军队，拼命飞去给九色鹿报信：“不好了，不好了，国王的军队来抓你了，九色鹿快跑啊。”
可是已经太晚了，在调达的指挥下，军队把九色鹿团团包围了起来。九色鹿，跑不掉了。

[P9] 士兵们围着九色鹿，一个个都张牙舞爪的，他们还拔出弓箭，威胁要射死九色鹿，让他赶快投降。
不过九色鹿一点都没有害怕，他还是那么安详：“是国王想找我吗？那我就跟你们去见见他吧。”说完他就站起身来静静地往前走，然后就像有魔法似的，国王的军队也安静了下来，慢慢地跟着九色鹿走向王宫。

[P10] 九色鹿在国王身边看到了调达，立刻就明白了一切。他把自己的故事告诉了国王：“我救了这个人的命，他也答应过不把我的行踪说出去，没想到他竟然是这样一个卑鄙无耻的小人，更没想到国王居然是这种小人的同伴。”

[P11] 听了九色鹿的故事，国王又感动又羞愧，他让人把调达抓了起来：
“你这个忘恩负义的家伙，害得我也差点跟着做了坏人。”
九色鹿安宁地离开王宫，回家去了，他最好的乌鸦朋友，兴高采烈地
陪着他一起走。至于那个调达，他被国王派人扔到恒河里面去了，这次，
还有谁会乐意去救他呢？
full_text_en:
[P1] Mao Mao Chong Children's Book Library
The Nine-Colored Deer
Zhang Shiming, Illustrations
Yao Yuan, Text
Xinlei Publishing House

[P2] Zhang Shiming (1939— )
    Graduated from Shanghai Xingzhi Art School in 1954, and from the Affiliated Middle School of the East China Branch of the Central Academy of Fine Arts in 1958. In the 1980s, he studied printmaking and mural art at the Art Students League in New York, USA. His fable picture books, including 'Waiting for Hares by the Stump', 'Mingling with the Crowd', and 'Banqiao's Three Daughters', won the International Board on Books for Young People (IBBY) Award. His book 'The Nine-Colored Deer' won the First Prize of the National Children's Picture Book Award.

[P3] Nine-Colored Deer
JIU
SE
LU
Zhang Shiming Illustrations
Yao Yuan Text

[P4] The Nine-Colored Deer lived by the banks of the Ganges River. It was a very, very big river, and the pure white Nine-Colored Deer lived peacefully and happily by its banks, accompanied by flowers, grass, and birds. His best friend, the little crow, always danced joyfully by his side.
But one day, a stranger appeared in the Ganges River—he didn’t come walking, but had fallen in and been carried by the current. The man floated up and down in the deep water, constantly shouting "Help!"

[P5] The water of the Ganges was big, swift, and dangerous; no one dared jump into the river to save the man. Only the brave Nine-Colored Deer jumped in without hesitation. Birds flew anxiously over the river, constantly shouting, "Come on, come on!"
Strange as it may seem, as soon as the Nine-Colored Deer jumped into the river, the water instantly became calm. The Nine-Colored Deer carried the drowning man on its back and swam all the way to the shore, bringing him back to its home.

[P6] The man named Diao Da desperately thanked the Nine-Colored Deer for saving his life, even kneeling down and offering to become his servant. The Nine-Colored Deer didn't need any servant. He told Diao Da, "Go back. This is not a place for you to live. But remember, never tell anyone where I live."
Diao Da left, and the Nine-Colored Deer continued living peacefully by the Ganges River. What he didn't expect was that soon after, the queen of the country suddenly had a dream, in which she saw a beautiful and peaceful Nine-Colored Deer.

[P7] The queen immediately found the king and said she wanted a beautiful nine-colored deer as a pet. But after searching the entire kingdom, no one knew where the nine-colored deer lived. So the king announced that if anyone could help him find the nine-colored deer, he would give half of the kingdom to them.
Hearing this news, Diao Da was overjoyed. He began calculating how to enjoy half the kingdom, and quickly ran to the palace to report the deer's whereabouts. He had long forgotten the deer's life-saving kindness and his own promise to the deer.

[P8] Diao Da brought the king's army to the Ganges River, arriving at the Nine-Colored Deer's homeland. The sharp-eyed crow was the first to see the massive army and flew desperately to warn the Nine-Colored Deer: "Oh no, oh no, the king's army has come to catch you, Nine-Colored Deer, run quickly!"
But it was already too late. Under Diao Da's command, the army surrounded the Nine-Colored Deer completely. The Nine-Colored Deer could not escape.

[P9] The soldiers surrounded the Nine-Colored Deer, snarling and brandishing their bows and arrows, threatening to shoot him dead and force him to surrender.
But the Nine-Colored Deer was not afraid at all. He remained calm: "Is the king looking for me? Then I'll go with you to meet him." After saying this, he stood up and walked quietly forward. As if by magic, the king's army also quieted down and slowly followed the Nine-Colored Deer toward the palace.

[P10] The Nine-Colored Deer saw Diao Da by the king's side and immediately understood everything. He told the king his story: "I saved this man's life, and he promised not to reveal my whereabouts. I never thought he would turn out to be such a despicable and shameless person, and even more, I never thought the king would be this kind of person's accomplice."

[P11] Having heard the story of the Nine-Colored Deer, the king was both moved and ashamed. He had调达 (Diao Da) arrested:
"You ungrateful scoundrel, you nearly made me become a bad person too."
The Nine-Colored Deer left the palace peacefully and returned home, accompanied by his best friend, the crow, who was delighted to walk with him. As for Diao Da, he was thrown into the Ganges River by the king's men. This time, who would be willing to save him?
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《九色鹿》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息和一幅色彩斑斓的九色鹿插画。
[P2] 本页展示了绘本《九色鹿》作者张世明的个人简介，包括其教育背景、艺术经历及主要获奖作品。
[P3] 本页展示了绘本《九色鹿》的书名页，包含书名、拼音及作者信息：张世明绘图，姚媛撰文。
[P4] 本页描绘了九色鹿在恒河边宁静幸福的生活，以及一天一个陌生人被河水冲来、在河中呼救的场景。
[P5] 九色鹿不顾危险跳入湍急的恒河，救起落水的陌生人，小鸟们在空中为它加油，河水在它跳入后奇迹般平静，它最终将人安全背回岸边。
[P6] 调达被九色鹿救后感激涕零，跪地请求成为其奴仆，九色鹿拒绝并叮嘱他保密住所；随后，九色鹿继续在恒河边生活，而王后则梦见了一只美丽安详的九色鹿。
[P7] 王后向国王请求得到九色鹿，国王悬赏寻找；调达得知后贪图赏赐，立即前往王宫告密，完全忘记了对九色鹿的救命之恩和承诺。
[P8] 调达带领国王的军队来到九色鹿的家园，乌鸦发现后急忙报信，但为时已晚，军队已在调达指挥下将九色鹿团团围住。
[P9] 九色鹿被士兵们包围并威胁，但它毫不畏惧，平静地同意前往王宫，士兵们也随之安静下来跟随它前行。
[P10] 九色鹿在国王面前认出背叛它的调达，向国王讲述了自己被背叛的经过，表达了对调达卑鄙行径和国王同流合污的震惊与失望。
[P11] 国王听闻九色鹿的遭遇后深受触动，将背叛者调达抓起并斥责其忘恩负义；九色鹿安然返回家园，乌鸦朋友陪伴左右，而调达则被扔进恒河，无人再愿救他。
